engine_cutoff_clock: MT5 encoded clock; real UTC = engine_cutoff - broker_clock_offset_seconds

freshness.rule: M15 freshness compares the engine latest_closed to the engine cutoff (real UTC cutoff + broker clock offset). D1/H4/H1 are SCHEDULE_DEPENDENT and are never called stale merely for closing before 08:15.

hash_basis: SHA-256 computed over UTF-8 bytes with line endings normalized to LF; byte counts are the actual file sizes; the manifest excludes itself.
run_log_note: run_log.json se genera tras el hash y no está incluido en files[].
